verdict.rationale: The firm has a dedicated Data Privacy, Security, Safety & Risk Management practice page. However, the quoted content covers only embedding privacy and security into client infrastructure as proactive compliance work. Nothing in the pack documents security-incident or breach response, or regulator-facing work such as notifications or investigations, so the adjacent privacy-compliance evidence earns no credit.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the firm handles security-incident and breach response, including regulator-facing work, documented on its own pages
